messages:
Ravi Desai: quick follow-up from today's postmortem/game-day: boiled down to three recurring pain points we should track as actions: routing overlap blackholes, intermittent snapshot replication misses, and ambiguous restore acceptance checks.
Mei Chen: +1. I logged the exact timings where control-plane updates overlapped with DNS swaps. saw ~30s of packet loss in one region.
Lucas Grant: for routing I recommend a 2-step policy rollout: hold (drain) -> apply -> gradual weight restore. Prototype nginx map below and will run a canary.
Mei Chen: ping on canary access: need a eu-canary pool. @Ravi can you grant?
Ravi Desai: granted access to `canary-eu-standby`.
Priya Rao: snapshot issue: 7/40 snapshots lacked replication tags because the lifecycle filter used `prefix: backups/` but snapshots live under `snapshots/`. I'll update replication config and add a verifier script. ETA: scan today, repair tomorrow.
Lucas Grant: routing snippet (concept):
```
# small-scale hold logic
if upstream_health < 85 then
  set weight=10
else
  set weight=100
end
```
I'll open a PR with real config and test plan.
Priya Rao: verifier will be `tools/snap-verify.sh --region eu --out missing.csv --fix` (dry-run default). Output CSV will include snapshot_id, created_at, expected_copies.
Mei Chen: runbook gaps: unclear replica_lag thresholds and missing post-restore checks. I'll update the runbook with exact SQL and expected ms windows. Draft by Fri EOD.
Ravi Desai: owner recap: Lucas = routing + canary (48h), Priya = snapshots + tool (24-48h), Mei = runbook acceptance criteria (Fri), Ravi = tracking & Jira epic. I'll create the epic now.
OpsBot: Jira EPIC RINF-2560 created: "Postgame: DR routing & backup remediation" by Ravi Desai.
Lucas Grant: plan for canary: 3 control-plane flaps with traffic generator, compare failover_convergence_ms baseline vs post-change. Will post numbers here.
Priya Rao: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/snap-tools/pull/321 (verifier draft).
Mei Chen: runbook PR: https://git.redwood/playbooks/dr-restore/pull/89 (includes CHECK_REPLICA SQL and explicit cutover timings).
Ravi Desai: timeline recap: verifier scan by +1d, snapshot repairs by +2d, routing canary + results by +3d, final runbook by +5d. Weekly check-ins until closed. If any blocker, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
